contradictions: Wave-level completion_test_met is not audit completion.
Non-empty CSV sentinel fields are not completed mappings.
Observer-only 88 of 95 cannot become the formal project-triage numerator.
Twenty-four unattributed deployed viewport cells cannot become current-source responsive coverage.
The 2812 visual rows do not establish the material visual-state denominator.
The physical 98-row register is 95 prompt repositories plus three historical extras, not 98 unique prompt projects.
